## User problem and evidence

Who needs this, for what job? Distinguish observations from assumptions.

## Existing scope and proposed change

Link affected FR/D/contract/packet. Explain whether this is existing acceptance,
an engineering choice or a product-scope change. References do not create scope.

## Alternatives, exclusions and acceptance

Describe bounded behavior, interaction/recovery/accessibility/compatibility risks,
testable outcomes and what remains application-owned. No dates/owners or
implementation/publication authority are implied by filing a proposal.
